```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(imcRtools)
library(dittoSeq)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
library(RColorBrewer)

dir.create("images", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Config

```{r config}
coord_cols <- c("Start_push", "End_push", "Pushes_duration", "X", "Y", "Z")

markers_of_interest <- c(
  "SMA", "CD4", "CD8a", "CD19", "CD15", "CD14", "CD86", "LAMP3",
  "Ki67", "CD138", "PD1", "PDL1", "FoxP3", "CD68", "CD163", "TIM3",
  "CD141", "CD11c", "CD56", "CD117", "EpCAM", "CD38", "CD45RO",
  "MKI67", "LAG3", "CD1c"
)

patient_levels <- c("12", "14", "17", "18", "19", "20_4_25", "20_5_19")

pt_colors <- setNames(
  colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(7, "Set2"))(7),
  rev(patient_levels)
)

base_dir     <- "/restricted/projectnb/camplab/projects/20220504_Suzuki_LN/TumorIMC/steinbock/"
raw_base_dir <- "/restricted/projectnb/camplab/projects/20220504_Suzuki_LN/Data/Imaging/IMC/Tumor/PardeeTumorAblations/"
```

# Load SPEs (post-seg)

```{r load_spes}
pt_dirs <- list(
  "12"      = paste0(base_dir, "p12_results/"),
  "14"      = paste0(base_dir, "p14_results/"),
  "17"      = paste0(base_dir, "p17_results/"),
  "18"      = paste0(base_dir, "p18_results/"),
  "19"      = paste0(base_dir, "p19_results/"),
  "20_4_25" = paste0(base_dir, "p20_4_25_results/"),
  "20_5_19" = paste0(base_dir, "p20_5_19_results/")
)

spe_list <- imap(pt_dirs, function(dir, pt) {
  spe <- read_steinbock(dir)
  spe$patient_id <- pt
  spe
})
```

# Combine SPEs

```{r combine_spes}
common_markers  <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(spe_list, rownames))
spe_list_trim   <- lapply(spe_list, function(s) s[common_markers, ])
spe_combined    <- do.call(cbind, spe_list_trim)

assay(spe_combined, "exprs") <- asinh(counts(spe_combined) / 1)

rowData(spe_combined)$use_channel <- !grepl(
  "DNA|Membrane", rownames(spe_combined), ignore.case = TRUE
)

metadata(spe_combined)$color_vectors <- list(patient_id = pt_colors)
```

# Build long data frames from SPE assays

```{r spe_long}
make_spe_long <- function(assay_name) {
  as.data.frame(t(assay(spe_combined, assay_name))) |>
    mutate(patient_id = factor(spe_combined$patient_id, levels = rev(patient_levels))) |>
    pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "marker", values_to = "intensity") |>
    filter(marker %in% markers_of_interest)
}

counts_long <- make_spe_long("counts")
exprs_long  <- make_spe_long("exprs")
```

# Load filtered pixels (0-100, pre-seg)

```{r load_filtered_pixels}
filtered_dirs <- list(
  "12"      = paste0(base_dir, "p12_results/filtered/"),
  "14"      = paste0(base_dir, "p14_results/filtered/"),
  "17"      = paste0(base_dir, "p17_results/filtered/"),
  "18"      = paste0(base_dir, "p18_results/filtered/"),
  "19"      = paste0(base_dir, "p19_results/filtered/"),
  "20_4_25" = paste0(base_dir, "p20_4_25_results/filtered/"),
  "20_5_19" = paste0(base_dir, "p20_5_19_results/filtered/")
)

set.seed(42)
pixels_filtered <- imap_dfr(filtered_dirs, function(dir, pt) {
  txt_files <- list.files(dir, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
  map_dfr(txt_files, function(f) {
    df <- read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)
    marker_cols <- setdiff(colnames(df), coord_cols)
    df[sample(nrow(df), min(50000, nrow(df))), marker_cols]
  }) |>
    mutate(patient_id = pt)
}) |>
  rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "\\(.*\\)$", "")) |>
  pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "marker", values_to = "intensity") |>
  filter(marker %in% markers_of_interest) |>
  mutate(patient_id = factor(patient_id, levels = rev(patient_levels)))
```

# Load raw unfiltered pixels

```{r load_raw_pixels}
raw_pt_dirs <- list(
  "12"      = file.path(raw_base_dir, "Patient_12T"),
  "14"      = file.path(raw_base_dir, "Patient_14T"),
  "17"      = file.path(raw_base_dir, "Patient_17T"),
  "18"      = file.path(raw_base_dir, "Patient_18T"),
  "19"      = file.path(raw_base_dir, "Patient_19T"),
  "20_4_25" = file.path(raw_base_dir, "4-25-2024_Patient 20-T"),
  "20_5_19" = file.path(raw_base_dir, "Patient_20T_5-19-2024")
)

set.seed(42)
pixels_raw <- imap_dfr(raw_pt_dirs, function(dir, pt) {
  txt_files <- list.files(dir, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
  map_dfr(txt_files, function(f) {
    df <- read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)
    marker_cols <- setdiff(colnames(df), coord_cols)
    df[sample(nrow(df), min(50000, nrow(df))), marker_cols]
  }) |>
    mutate(patient_id = pt)
}) |>
  rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "\\(.*\\)$", "")) |>
  pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "marker", values_to = "intensity") |>
  filter(marker %in% markers_of_interest) |>
  mutate(patient_id = factor(patient_id, levels = rev(patient_levels)))
```

# Marker split

```{r marker_split}
markers_use <- intersect(markers_of_interest, unique(pixels_filtered$marker))
half        <- ceiling(length(markers_use) / 2)
markers_1   <- markers_use[1:half]
markers_2   <- markers_use[(half + 1):length(markers_use)]
```

# Plot functions

```{r plot_functions}
plot_ridges <- function(data, markers_subset, part, assay_label, xlab,
                        subtitle = "50,000 pixels sampled per ROI") {
  plot_df <- data |>
    filter(marker %in% markers_subset) |>
    mutate(marker = factor(marker, levels = markers_subset))

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = intensity, y = patient_id, fill = patient_id)) +
    geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.7, scale = 1.2, linewidth = 0.3,
                        rel_min_height = 0.01) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pt_colors) +
    facet_wrap(~ marker, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3,
               labeller = label_value) +
    labs(
      title    = paste0("Staining distributions — ", assay_label, " (part ", part, ")"),
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x        = xlab,
      y        = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position  = "none",
      strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "grey60"),
      plot.title       = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40")
    )

  fname <- file.path("images", paste0("ridgeplot_",
                     gsub("[^a-z0-9]", "_", tolower(assay_label)),
                     "_part", part, ".png"))
  ggsave(fname, p, width = 14, height = 20, dpi = 150)
  message("saved: ", fname)
  print(p)
}

plot_ridges_raw <- function(data, markers_subset, part) {
  plot_df <- data |>
    filter(marker %in% markers_subset) |>
    mutate(marker = factor(marker, levels = markers_subset))

  x_limits <- plot_df |>
    group_by(marker) |>
    summarise(upper = quantile(intensity, 0.99), .groups = "drop")

  plot_df <- plot_df |>
    left_join(x_limits, by = "marker") |>
    mutate(intensity = pmin(intensity, upper))

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = intensity, y = patient_id, fill = patient_id)) +
    geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.7, scale = 1.2, linewidth = 0.3,
                        rel_min_height = 0.01) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pt_colors) +
    facet_wrap(~ marker, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3,
               labeller = label_value) +
    labs(
      title    = paste0("Staining distributions — Raw reads unfiltered (part ", part, ")"),
      subtitle = "x axis clipped at 99th percentile per marker\n50,000 pixels sampled per ROI",
      x        = "Intensity",
      y        = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position  = "none",
      strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "grey60"),
      plot.title       = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40")
    )

  fname <- file.path("images", paste0("ridgeplot_raw_unfiltered_part", part, ".png"))
  ggsave(fname, p, width = 14, height = 20, dpi = 150)
  message("saved: ", fname)
  print(p)
}
```

# Ridgeplots

## Raw reads (unfiltered)

```{r plot_raw, fig.width=14, fig.height=20}
for (part in 1:2) {
  markers_i <- if (part == 1) markers_1 else markers_2
  plot_ridges_raw(pixels_raw, markers_i, part)
}
```

## Filtered pixels (0-100, pre-seg)

```{r plot_filtered, fig.width=14, fig.height=20}
for (part in 1:2) {
  markers_i <- if (part == 1) markers_1 else markers_2
  plot_ridges(pixels_filtered, markers_i, part,
              assay_label = "Filtered pixel (0-100)",
              xlab        = "Intensity")
}
```

## Post-seg counts (0-100)

```{r plot_counts, fig.width=14, fig.height=20}
for (part in 1:2) {
  markers_i <- if (part == 1) markers_1 else markers_2
  plot_ridges(counts_long, markers_i, part,
              assay_label = "Post-seg (0-100)",
              xlab        = "Intensity",
              subtitle    = NULL)
}
```

## Post-seg asinh

```{r plot_exprs, fig.width=14, fig.height=20}
for (part in 1:2) {
  markers_i <- if (part == 1) markers_1 else markers_2
  plot_ridges(exprs_long, markers_i, part,
              assay_label = "Post-seg asinh",
              xlab        = "asinh(Intensity)",
              subtitle    = NULL)
}
```
